sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 384x288, 12 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <= 20 mK; optical: 1/1.8in progressive scan CMOS
features: anti-corrosion (NEMA 4X) thermal and optical bi-spectrum network positioning system (PTZ), pan 360 continuous / tilt -85 to +85
optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 56x optical zoom (6-336 mm)
temperature measurement -20 to 150 C, accuracy +/-8 C
fire detection (up to 10 fire points) and smoke detection (up to 6 km with 5x5 m smoke)
VCA perimeter protection: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance and exit
thermal detector: 384x288, 12 um pixel pitch, VOx UFPA, NETD <= 20 mK, 8-14 um
laser IR illuminator up to 2000 m
built-in TPM 2.0 encryption, self-cleaning module, wiper, BNC analog thermal video output, RS-485
release_notes: The HIKMICRO HM-TD6338-50C4L is an anti-corrosion (NEMA 4X) thermal and optical bi-spectrum network positioning system with a 384x288 12 um VOx thermal detector, a 4 MP long-range optical zoom channel, a 2000 m laser illuminator, temperature measurement (-20 to 150 C) and fire/smoke detection for perimeter protection at ports, docks and coastal sites. Verified against the official HIKMICRO datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal (Channel 2) and optical (Channel 1) exposed as separate channels.
